subject: Request: HackRelay maintainer credit + trial extension
messages:
From: Samira Khatri <samira@openmesh.dev>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: HackRelay: maintainer credit + trial extension request

Hi Marissa,

Hope you're doing well — I'm Samira, community lead at OpenMesh. We're running HackRelay (June 28-30), a free 48-hour relay for maintainers who mentor contributors across projects. We had about 120 signups from maintainers last year and expect similar volume this year.

A few asks:
- Community credits for ~25 maintainers to run small experiments (so they can test model-backed tooling during the event). Ideally a 6-week trial extension per maintainer or pooled promo credits that they can redeem.
- A short one-pager and budget we can show sponsors (attached).

We value Redwood's past support — if there's a standard promo flow or a way to drop a single promo code per org that we can distribute to maintainers, that would be ideal. Happy to be flexible on amount.

Attachments: hackrelay_event_one-pager.pdf, budget_breakdown.xlsx

Thanks — would love to get this sorted before June 18 so we can announce in the organizer comms.

—Samira
Samira Khatri
Community Lead, OpenMesh
samira@openmesh.dev
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HackRelay: maintainer credit + trial extension request

Looping you both in — Samira (OpenMesh) asked for maintainer credits / 6-week trial extensions for HackRelay (June 28-30). They attached a short one-pager and a budget. They want either per-maintainer 6-week trials or a pooled promo code we can distribute.

Quick context: small non-profit event, high maintainer signal for OSS, good community optics. Costs are modest; I'd be inclined to approve a pooled promo + a small stipend for maintainers, but want alignment on spend and any guardrails.

Can we do: 25 x 6-week trials OR a $2k pooled credit to distribute? If we go pooled, what's the best redemption flow (single promo vs multiple codes)? Also: legal/compliance/PRM checks?

Thanks — Marissa

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Samira Khatri <samira@openmesh.dev>
Date: Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 9:15 AM
Subject: HackRelay: maintainer credit + trial extension request
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

(see above)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HackRelay: maintainer credit + trial extension request

Marissa / Laura — happy to greenlight something here. Proposed: $2,500 pooled credit tied to the HackRelay org, redeemable via a single promo link that we can TTL to expire after 6 weeks. That should give organizers flexibility and keeps redemption scoped.

Conditions:
- Credits for non-commercial usage only (community/hacky projects).
- Organizer has to share a short post-event usage summary (simple form).
- Attachments look fine; budget is modest.

Operational ask: Can you add "HackRelay promo" as a special code in HubSpot/Promo tool and route redemptions through customer-support if we need to revoke? I'll approve $2.5k from the community fund.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Platform Partnerships
ben_carter@redwood.ai

On Jun 7, 2027, at 10:05 AM, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Looping you both in — Samira (OpenMesh) asked for maintainer credits / 6-week trial extensions for HackRelay (June 28-30).
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HackRelay: maintainer credit + trial extension request

Thanks — $2.5k sounds reasonable. Two quick asks before we finalize:
1) Cap per-redeemer: set a $150 max per maintainer to avoid a few folks consuming most credits.
2) Require the post-event usage summary within 3 weeks; if not submitted, we pause future credits for the organizer.

If we're OK with those, I approve from the community fund. Please make sure Finance tags this as community promo (Q3 budget).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Manager, Developer Relations
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

On Jun 7, 2027, at 11:42 AM, Ben Carter wrote:
> Proposed: $2,500 pooled credit tied to the HackRelay org, redeemable via a single promo link that we can TTL to expire after 6 weeks.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khatri <samira@openmesh.dev>, ops@hackrelay.org
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HackRelay: maintainer credit + trial extension request

Hi Samira / HackRelay team — great to connect.

Short version: Redwood will provide a $2,500 pooled promo credit for HackRelay, redeemable via a single promo link. Details / guardrails:
- Promo total: $2,500 USD
- Per-redeemer cap: $150
- Promo expiry: 6 weeks from first redemption (we'll set the TTL from issuance to 8 weeks to account for staggered signups)
- Usage: community / non-commercial only
- Post-event: we require a one-page usage summary within 3 weeks after HackRelay ends; we'll send a short intake form.

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm the organizer email that will receive the promo link.
2) Share preferred organizer display name (this is what appears in the redemption flow).
3) Sign the short community promo terms (we'll send a DocuSign link).

I've CC'd Ben and Laura for visibility. Ben — please add the promo on your end and share the redemption URL once live. Finance: tag as community promo (Q3).

Attachments referenced: hackrelay_event_one-pager.pdf, budget_breakdown.xlsx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Samira Khatri <samira@openmesh.dev>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HackRelay: maintainer credit + trial extension request

Marissa, this is fantastic — thank you to you and the team.

Please send the promo link to ops@hackrelay.org and use display name: "HackRelay — OpenMesh organizers". We'll sign the terms when you send them. We'll also prepare the post-event summary and send it to the email on the DocuSign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will announce the promo to maintainers once we have the link.

—Samira
